state:
- Specificity is exceptional in its locked subgroup thresholds, genotype-tracked differentiation and post-washout transplantation endpoints. However, baseline salvage fractions measure pathway use, not compensatory capacity. Test salvage during DHODH inhibition under physiological uridine conditions and manipulate salvage capacity to establish causality.
- Novelty remains unresolved: S4 already supports DHODH-mediated AML differentiation, while the teriflunomide-specific literature is unchecked. Compare prior teriflunomide/leflunomide AML studies against the precise salvage-defined residual-cell prediction before claiming novelty.
- Drug approval, pharmacology and achievable unbound exposure remain unverified, although appropriately labeled. Complete those checks and specify exposure-compatible dosing; also prespecify a minimum salvage-by-treatment interaction and donor-level power, rather than leaving response enrichment qualitative.
